title: Finite Element Modelling of a Cellular Electric Microenvironment
protocol: Build the model in COMSOL.
Select Blank Model.
Right-click on Global Definitions and select Parameters.
Add parameters according to Table 1.
Right-click on Material under Global Definitions and select Blank Material.
Expand Material Properties > Basic Properties, select Relative Permittivity, and press the '+' symbol to add property.
Repeat the step for Electrical Conductivity.
Fill in the current material properties according to Table 2.
Left-click Add Component and select 3D.
Right-click Geometry and left-click insert.
Double-click on Full Model and select the appropriate sequence (SC/SNC/RC/RNC/RNCd).
Change the Length unit to nm in the Settings window.
Leave "Scale values when changing units" unchecked.
Right-click on Geometry and select Block.
Fill in the Label "Scaffold extents".
Right click Geometry in the Model Builder and select Cylinder.
Edit the Settings tab for the newly created element.
Change the label to "Coat".
Expand Size and Shape, fill in "Rf" and "Lf" for Radius and Height respectively.
Expand Position, fill in "-excess*Ws/2" and "-Lf/2" for x and y coordinates respectively.
Expand Axis, change axis type to y-axis.
Expand Layers, fill in "Rf-Rc" for Thickness.
Check only the "Layers on side".
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities, add "Coat Selection".
Right click Geometry in the Model Builder and select Delete Entities.
Change Geometric Entry Level to Domain.
Choose Coat Selection for Selection.
Remove all domains but domain 3 from the selection box.
Select Coat Selection in the Selections of Resulting Entities.
Right click Geometry in the Model Builder and select Cylinder.
Right click the newly created element and select Duplicate.
Edit their Settings tab as follows.
Set Label to "Coat 1" / "Coat 2".
Set radius to Rf.
Set height to "D*prop"/"D*(1-prop)" for each cylinder respectively.
Expand Position, fill in "-excess*Ws/2" on x and "-Lf/2"/"-Lf/2+D*prop" on y for each cylinder respectively.
Expand Axis, change axis type to y-axis.
Expand Layers section, fill in "Rf-Rc".
Check only the "Layers on side".
Expand Selections of resulting entities, create "Coat 1 Selection"/ "Coat 2 Selection".
Delete entities under Geometry in the Model Builder.
Change Geometric Entry Level to Domain in the Settings tab.
Select cylinder 2 (cyl2) and cylinder 3 (cyl3) from the graphics window.
Remove all domains but domain 3 from the selection box.
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities, create Coat Selection.
Right click Geometry, expand Transforms and select Array.
Set Input objects to "Coat Selection".
Set Array type to Linear.
Set Size to "Lf/D".
Set Displacement on y axis to "D".
In the Model Builder, right click Geometry, expand Transforms and select Rotate.
Turn on the Input objects Switch and select Core Selection from the dropdown list.
Expand Rotation Angle and fill in "theta" for Rotation.
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities and create "Fiber Selection".
Right click Geometry, Expand Transforms and select Array.
Change label to "Core Array".
Select Core Selection in the dropdown list for Input objects.
Set Array type to Linear.
Fill in "n_1*(theta<=45) +n_2*(theta>45)" for Size.
Expand Displacement and fill in "2*tes*Rc*cos(theta)", "2*tes*Rc*sin(theta)" for x and y.
Coat Array (skip to 1.6.5.3 if SNC)
Right-click Geometry in the Model Builder.
Expand Transforms and select Rotate.
In the Settings tab, turn on the Input objects Switch and select Coat Selection.
Ensure "Keep input objects box" is not checked.
Expand Rotation Angle and fill in "theta" for Rotation.
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities and select "Fiber Selection".
Right-click Geometry in the Model Builder again.
Expand Transforms and select Array.
Change label to "Coat Array".
Select Coat Selection in the dropdown list for Input objects.
Expand Size, change Array type to Linear and fill in "n_1*(theta<=45) + n_2*(theta>45)" for Size.
Expand Displacement and fill in "2*tes*Rc*cos(theta)", "2*tes*Rc*sin(theta)" for x and y.
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities and select "Fiber Selection".
Unite Fibers
Right-click Geometry in the Model Builder.
Expand Booleans and Partitions and select Union.
Change label to "Fibers".
Turn on Input objects switch and select Fiber Selection from the dropdown list.
Ensure "Keep input objects" box is not checked and "Keep interior boundaries" is checked.
Expand Selections of Resulting Entities and select Scaffold Selection from the dropdown list.
Perform cut
Right-click Geometry in the Model Builder again.
Expand Booleans and Partitions and select Intersection.
Change label to "Scaffold".
Turn on Input objects switch and select Scaffold Selection from the dropdown list.
In Model Builder, left click the model root node.
Select Add Study to open the Add Study tab.
Select Stationary Study and right click Add Study button.
Under Study node, right click Step1: Stationary Study and select Duplicate.
For each study step, modify the settings tab with the details of the corresponding component.
Expand Physics and Variables Selection.
In the Solve for column, leave only the current component checked.
Expand Study Extensions and check Adaptive mesh refinement box.
Select current component's geometry from the dropdown list next to Adaptation in geometry.
Right click Study 1 and select Compute.
Under Global definitions, left click Parameters and change parameter theta to the fiber orientation angle desired for simulation.
In Model Builder, expand the component's node.
Right click Geometry and select Build all.
Left click the model root node and select Add Study to open the Add Study tab.
Select Stationary Study and right click Add Study button.
In Model Builder, under the newly added study, left click Step 1.
Expand mesh selection and select the meshes generated in the adaptive mesh refinement study for each component.
Right click Compute button.
Set orientation angle.
Input signal.
Perform time dependent study.
Left click Parameters under Global definitions.
Change parameter theta to the fiber orientation angle desired for simulation.
Select Add Study tab by left clicking the model root node.
Add Time Dependent Study and edit Settings tab as follows.
Set Times to "range(0, (2*pi/omega)/39,2*pi/omega)".
Expand Physics and Variables Selection; leave only the simulation component "Solve for" check box checked.
Expand Mesh selection and select a mesh for the simulation component.
Change other components' meshes to No mesh.
Expand Study Extensions and check Adaptive mesh refinement box; select the simulation component's geometry from the dropdown list.
Define time dependent boundary condition.
Right click Definitions under the current component node.
Select Waveform under Functions.
In Settings tab change Function name to "Input".
Expand Parameters, set Type to Sine.
Set Angular frequency to "omega".
Set Amplitude to V0.
Under Electric Currents node of simulation component select Terminal and change Voltage to "Input(t[1/s])".
Right click Compute button.
Right click Results node, select 3D Plot Group and edit Settings.
Change label to "Charge density".
Expand Data and select the Parametric study dataset in the Data set dropdown list.
Expand Color Legend and check "Show legends" and "Show maximum and minimum values".
Right click Charge density under the Results node in the Model Builder and select Volume.
Edit Settings tab.
Expand Data and select "From parent" from Data set dropdown list.
Expand Expression and fill in "ec.rhoq" in the Expression box.
Expand Range and check Manual color range box.
Set minimum to "-0.03".
Set maximum to "0.03".
Expand Coloring and Style, set Coloring to Color table, Color table to Wave.
Check Color legend box.
Check Symmetrize color range.
Right click Volume in Model Builder and select Filter.
In the Settings tab fill in "abs(ec.rhoq)>0.012" in the Logical expression for inclusion.
Left click on the Plot button to visualize results in the graphics window.
Current density
In the Model Builder right click the Results node, select 3D Plot Group and edit the Settings tab.
Change label to "Current density".
Expand Data and select the Parametric study dataset in the Data set dropdown list.
Expand Color Legend, check "Show legends" and "Show maximum and minimum values".
Right click Current density under the Results node in Model Builder and select Arrow Volume.
Proceed to edit Settings tab.
Expand Data and select "From parent" from Data set dropdown list.
Expand Expression and fill in "ec.Jx", "ec.Jy", "ec.Jz" in the Expression boxes for the x, y and z components respectively.
Expand Arrow positioning and fill in 20 for all coordinates number of points.
Expand Coloring and Style, set Arrow length to Normalized.
Expand Coloring and Style, set Arrow base to Center.
Expand Coloring and Style, check Scale factor and set it to 85.
Right click Arrow Volume in Model Builder and select Color Expression.
In the Settings tab fill in "ec.normJ" in the Expression box.
Expand Coloring and Style, set Color table to Traffic.
Expand Coloring and Style, check Color legend.
Expand Coloring and Style, Reverse color table.
Click on the Plot button to visualize results in the graphics window.
